info.title: concord-app
info.description: Concord app: the request pipeline shared by every route: error envelope, cursors, idempotency, telemetry

Board.description: The board payload: `{cards, columns}` for one project slug.

BoardCard.description:
One card on the board, with the name of the column it sits in.

A card is either a row in `board_cards` (somebody placed it) or *derived* from the feature's own
status. A derived card has no row, so `id` and `column_id` are zero and it is addressed by
`feature_id`; `derived` is what says so, and `title` is carried only for derived cards because a
placed card's title is the feature's and the board page reads it from the feature.

Call.description: A consensus call, in the Go struct's wire shape.

created_at.description:
Zero in the list endpoint: the Go feed query does not select it, and the field is not
`omitempty`, so the wire carries `created_at: 0`. Reproduced rather than corrected, because a
client that reads it as a timestamp would otherwise start seeing a value where it saw none.

feature_id.description: 0 for a process decision that is not about one feature.

opened_early.description:
§6.5's "early calls are flagged as such". Absent for a call that predates the column, so it
reads as "not flagged" rather than claiming it was considered.

outcome.description: §6.5's decision about the solution, distinct from `result`, which is §6.6's verdict on the call.

result.description: Present and null when there is no verdict — the Go field has no `omitempty`.

solution_id.description: §6.5's subject: the solution a call opens on. Absent for a process decision.

summary.description: Present and null while the call is open.

Census.description: The composition of the instance: what exists, not what happened.

complaints_by_status.description: Complaints, by status, with the provenance split.

features_by_effort.description: Features, by effort, with the provenance split.

features_by_status.description: Features, by status, with the provenance split.

projects_by_license.description: Projects, by license, with `''` reported as `unknown` (25 at most).

merged_into.description: Absent, not null, when the complaint is not merged — `omitempty` in the Go struct.

body.description:
The whole document text. The Go list shape carries it, so this one does too — a list that
omits the body is a different API, and `/documents` is a small list of long strings.

actor_display_name.description:
The actor's display name — never the username, never the email.

`users` has an email column and this log is meant to be read by anyone, so an email here would
be a permanent exposure. A numeric actor id alone is useless to a reader, which is why the
name is resolved at all.

can_undo.description:
Whether this caller may reverse the act. Always false for the anonymous reader: the flag is a
hint for a viewer, and the restore route re-checks it, because a flag computed in a read is not
a permission.

undoes.description: The act this entry reverses, when it is a reversal.

undone.description: Some later act has reversed THIS one.

FacetCount.description: One value of a plain facet: a table that cannot be filled by an import.

Feature.description: One feature, as `/api/v1/projects/{slug}/features` and `/features/{id}` return it.

FeaturePriority.description: One feature's priority, with its inputs.

theme_weight.description: §6.2's tag-scoped half of the μ term, summed from the live themes this feature's tags match.

Inbox.description: One inbox page, plus the badge.

unread.description: How many of the reader's rows are unread — over the whole inbox, not this page.

Item.description: One row of the queue: a proposal of any kind, or a moderation act.

can_vote.description:
Filled here rather than in the store, because eligibility depends on the request's actor and on
rules the store does not own. A page that renders the button regardless offers an action the server
will refuse, and the refusal reads as a broken page rather than as a rule.

contested.description: Derived, never stored: the instance's existing dissent threshold.

decided_at.description: When it was decided, 0 while open.

id.description: The row in its own table.

project_id.description: The project it belongs to, 0 for instance-wide.

project_slug.description: Its slug, so the page can link without a second read.

summary.description: The one-line summary a reviewer reads first.

median_hours.description: Median hours, and zero when `n` is zero — never a median of nothing.

n.description: How many episodes contributed a duration.

unit.description: Always `hours`, so a reader never has to guess the unit.

unmeasured.description: Ended, never started — finished work with no recorded beginning.

LatencySection.description: The three latencies, each carrying its own `n`.

Measured.description: How much of the instance is instrumented, as opposed to how much exists.

with_origin.description: Features a writer that names its source has touched (`origin <> 'unknown'`).

Milestone.description: One milestone with its computed counts.

seeded.description: Features with no creation audit event — i.e. the seeding script's.

unshipped.description: Shipped features with no shipment event.

MilestoneSlippage.description: How late a milestone is, which is a different question for a closed one than an open one.

oldest_open_days.description: How long the oldest unfinished feature has waited. Only an open milestone has one.

slip_days.description: Positive when the last shipment came after the target date. Only a closed milestone has one.

Notification.description: One row of the reader's inbox.

actor.description: Who decided. Omitted when the account is gone, and the page renders "a moderator".

project_slug.description: Its slug, so a client can link without a second read. Omitted when the project is gone.

read.description: Whether the reader has seen it.

reason.description: Why, in the moderator's own words.

Page.description: One page plus the total it was drawn from.

Project.description: A row of `projects` joined to its metrics, in the shape `/api/v1/projects/{slug}` serves.

ai_involvement.description:
What the project DECLARES about AI involvement in its own code: `human`, `assisted`, `generated`, `audited`, or `None` for
"not declared".

`None` is not "no AI" and it is not "unknown-but-probably-fine": it is the absence of a claim, and the badge renders nothing for it.
The declaration is written by a person with a role in the project — never inferred from commit metadata, a model's guess, or the
project's age — because the whole value of the label is that somebody stood behind it.

stage.description:
Where the project is in its life — `seed`, `sprout`, `mature`, `dormant` or `unknown`.

COMPUTED at read time from the columns beside it, never stored: `concord_ranking::lifecycle` is a pure reading of measurements
this query already selects, and a stored copy would be a second truth that goes stale the moment the sweep runs
(`docs/plans/post-port-roadmap.md`, step 2).

stage_because.description:
The sentence that justifies the stage. A label with no reason is one a reader can only take on faith, and the sweep that marks
projects dormant has to be able to say why it did.

ProvenanceCount.description: One value of a three-way provenance facet.

seeded.description: `origin IN ('seed','import')` — brought in by a batch.

unknown.description: `origin = 'unknown'` — predates the provenance backfill. NOT organic.

ResponsivenessRow.description: One row of the newcomer-responsiveness ranking.

hours.description: Median hours from a newcomer's first PR to the first response by somebody else.

n.description:
How many first PRs the median rests on. Part of the row, because two projects at the same median are
not the same claim when one rests on 5 PRs and the other on 500.

Snapshot.description: One recorded day of instance statistics.

complaints_seed.description: Complaints that came from a seed or an import.

decision_n.description: How many episodes the decision median rests on.

delivery_n.description: How many episodes the delivery median rests on.

features_seed.description: Features that came from a seed or an import.

no_origin.description: Features with no provenance at all.

projects_measured.description: Projects with at least one measured signal.

triage_median_h.description: The triage median, or `null` when the day had no sample. A median of zero is not the same answer.

triage_n.description: How many episodes the triage median rests on.

StatsPayload.description: `GET /api/v1/stats` — the one payload the statistics page renders from.

generated_at.description: When this was computed, in unix seconds.

Weights.description:
The charter weights the score needs. Defaults are the baseline's, for a project whose charter has
not been written yet — a project without a charter is not an error, it is a project with defaults.

pain_halflife_days.description: How fast a complaint's pain decays.
